reviews.text: Very nice establishment, friendly staff, care about animals...quite pricey.

The staff at Duke Animal Hospital are wonderful and take the time to properly care for your animals and understand what issues they are having. The pricing is very upfront and they explain what is needed immediately vs. what is optional or can wait for the next visit. They have a whole wing dedicated to cat-friendly rooms, which have calming videos playing and calming pheromone plug ins. I highly recommend Duke for both regular check ups and emergency visits.

Corey, thank you for your 5-star post.  We are honored that you have selected Duke Animal Hospital as health care provider for your (extensive!) animal family.  Know that all of us appreciate your taking the time post.  Take care, and give our best to your menagerie.  Sally F / Service Liaison

We have a dog with reactivity and severe anxiety. We had brought him to Duke for several years. Their prices are reasonable to Low for within the city. The staff is incredibly responsive, and their online pharmacy is very convenient. Most importantly they have always been open and willing to work with us with medication and other approaches to try to help our dog. All the vets we have worked with are amazing, but Angie Duke is one of a kind. Would recommend this business to anybody.

Nick, thanks so much for the 5-star post!  All of us at Duke Animal Hospital have enjoyed working with you and Erica, and are delighted you chose Duke Animal Hospital for Harvey's health care.  Know how much all of us appreciate your taking the time to post, and please give our best to Harvey!   Sally F / Service Liaison

Another greedy private equity vet (Mission Pet Health).  This place is NOT privately owned as they would have you believe. Dr. Duke sold out to private equity but you wouldn't know that because there is no mention of this on their website. Not only is the service expensive and subpar, but they will make mistakes with treatments and care and not tell you about it. Do not take your pet here if you care about their wellbeing. The staff is also very unprofessional. I saw staff on their phones and wearing headphones instead of helping clients. They chat like high schoolers.
edit: now they are having staff write reviews to push down reviews like mine. Grace Chen is a doctor who works for Mission Pet Health... if that doesn't tell you how shady this place is i'm not sure what will!

Over the years we have come to value the care and concern, the staff at Duke has given our previous cats and now our current dog. We appreciate their efforts to accommodate our needs in a timely manner. They create a calm and safe environment for pets and their owners while providing professional animal health care.

I completely trust Dr. Coulombe with my dog, Walrus. Dr. Coulombe was so kind and used Fear Free techniques on my fearful dog, which made the experience so much better.

She followed up with the lab results promptly, and gave a detailed breakdown of Walrus’ health.

We will definitely be back to see Dr. Coulombe again! ✨

I have been taking both of my cats-Mimi and Layla to this clinic for several years and can say that the care they receive is exceptional. The techs and front desk staff do a wonderful job at fitting you in for same-day visits and making sure that communication is relayed accordingly. Most of all, Dr. Alore is a wonderful provider that explains everything throughly and provides you with affordable options to ensure you make the best decision for your furry babies (and your pocket). She goes above and beyond on every visit and always takes her time answering my questions. I will continue bringing my cats here for care because I can trust that the staff have their best interest in mind!

I was relieved when I found Duke Animal Hospital after having countless bad experiences at other vets this year. Great vets in the Chicago area. I found their services affordable, the staff is knowledgeable and caring of your pets. I would feel comfortable with them as my primary pet care team and bringing my dog Media and other pets here again in the future.
I come with my cousin Carol and her pets. Dr. Duke and her staff are wonderful and caring people. A credit to their profession.
Great staff, speedy service.

Thank you for your 5-star rating!  Though we're not 100% sure which of our patients belongs to you, we're delighted to know you've been pleased Duke Animal Hospital care for your pet.  We appreciate you taking the time to post!  Sally F / Service Liaison

We are in Chicago from out of town for a few days and we brought our dog who had a laceration repaired yesterday. Unfortunately, it reopened today and we contacted Duke animal Hospital. They were great from the jump. They were able to see us very early this morning, and we’re efficient, courteous, thorough, and very communicative. It was very reassuring to speak with the tech and the doctor. We are from out of town, but based on this emergency visit, I would be very happy to recommend them.

Ron, thank you so very much for your 5-star rating.  Your relationship with Duke Animal Hospital spans nearly a decade; it has been our collective pleasure to work with you in caring for Charlie.  He enjoyed a long life with you and his person, and we were grateful to get to know him.  Please know how much all of us appreciate your taking the time to post.  Sally F / Service Liasion

Everyone at Duke's are friendly, professional and amazing. They got my cat in for an emergency visit the same day and took care of her
very well. We have brought multiple cats of ours in here and have been quite satisfied. They are very caring and thoughtful too.

Thank you for your 5-star rating!  It's been our pleasure to meet and work with you over the last year, and we are glad you chose Duke Animal Hospital for Janet and Toshi's care.  Please give them our regards =^..^=  =^..^= and know how much we appreciate you taking the time to post.  Sally F / Service Liaison

Allison, thanks for the 5-star rating!  We are pleased that you and Alex have chosen Duke Animal Hospital as care provider for Basil and look forward to many more years working together.  Know how much we appreciate you taking the time to post, and please give our best to Ms. Basil, she's a winner!  Sally F / Service Liasion

Duke Animal Hospital was absolutely wonderful during an incredibly stressful time for our family. From the moment we arrived, the staff showed genuine compassion, kindness, and professionalism. Every team member—from the front desk to the veterinary staff—treated us and our pet with such care and understanding.

They took the time to listen to our concerns, answered all of our questions thoroughly, and made sure our pet was comfortable every step of the way. Their level of empathy and dedication was truly remarkable, and it was clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat.

The staff went above and beyond to provide not only excellent medical care but also emotional support during a difficult situation. Their kindness, patience, and expertise made all the difference.

We are so grateful for the amazing team at Duke Animal Hospital and highly recommend them to anyone looking for compassionate, high-quality veterinary care. Wonderful, caring, and truly exceptional staff.

Duke Animal Hospital saved the day again! My dog Marley has been struggling with a cough and Duke was able to get us in right away. They treated him so nice and calm. We ended up getting him medicine for his cough and the staff did everything to make him comfortable and safe. My vet Dr. Megan Bradsfield was super friendly and very helpful in letting me know what’s wrong with Marley. Thank you again!
Everyone who works here is very nice.

Here are some facts. My 15 year old cat Izzie was diagnosed with stage 2 kidney disease last December and recommended for an abdominal ultrasound.  She had no other health problems at this point other than high blood pressure.  I took Izzie for an ultrasound at Duke in January.  When we picked her up, she was completely blind and confused (this turned out to be a permanent change). Her back claw was somehow ripped out by someone on staff.  Duke acted like they had no idea anything was wrong with her post ultrasound when we freaked out.  Something traumatic happened to Izzie during her ultrasound and I'll never know what.  Needless to say I moved her care elsewhere immediately (Medvet and Blum).  It was the start of her decline over the next three months.  So would I trust anyone at this vet practice with another pet? 100% no.

Evan, delayed response notwithstanding, please know that all of at Duke Animal Hospital appreciate you taking the time to rate us.  It's been our pleasure working with you over the last year, and we hope to continue ... and earn that 5th star.  Please give our best to Fergie, Mabel and Scotch and may all of you have a terrific summer!  Sally F / Service Liaison

I spent @$6000 on my cat in a month: teeth removal, checkups etc.  My cat was ok after the teeth removal surgery for less than two and a half weeks.  Then she quickly  died from a large cancerous tumor in her jaw. That begs the question: didn’t dr Duke notice a large jaw tumor when she did the teeth surgery? And then not angrily but sheepishly after a short uncomfortable period Dr Duke said she didn’t want me to come to her anymore.  But she kept all the money, which btw was 40% higher priced than my current vet.  She was at this  time doing renovations and expansion of her business.

I can’t  recommend this vet.  I feel like I made a terrible mistake in trusting this woman.  Money hungry and unethical at best, incompetent at worst, she lies between these two dimensions. No to dr Duke. NO
Edit to the review: we have since left Duke as clients after multiple times of visiting, feeling dismissed, and being treated like a number.

Hillary, this is a very delayed but appreciative THANK YOU for your 5-star post, from all of us at Duke Animal Hospital.  It's been our privilege and pleasure to care for your animal family over the last 7 years and we're honored you chose us.  Have a wonderful summer, and give our best to Moka, Pogo and Sebastian!  Sally F / Service Liaison
We’ve had very good experiences at Duke Animal Hospital for our cats. Kind & compassionate care — and free parking!

Can’t say enough great things about this office and all of the staff. We came here for an emergency with my dog and they took such great care of him. You can tell they all truly care about animals, and treated my pittie like he was theirs! ❤️‍🩹 …
Cat owner here, Duke’s always been great and I would highly recommend!

Shelby, thanks for the 5-stars!  All of us at Duke Animal Hospital and happy that you and Joey have chosen us to provide care for Ms. Poppy.  It’s been our collective pleasure to work with all 3 of you for the last year and a half.  Know how much we appreciate your taking the time to review us, and please give our best to Poppy!  Sally F /Service Liasion

Duke Animal Hospital is amazing! The staff is extremely responsive both via phone and email. They scheduled me immediately as I was worried my dog was injured. Dr. Benjamin was so nice and did not try to add any additional costs to my visit. Prices were very reasonable. So thankful for them!

Katie, thank you so much for your 5-star review.  Know how much all of us at Duke Animal Hospital appreciate your taking the time to post.  It’s certainly been our pleasure to work with you in support of Olive’s health the last several years and we wish you, Olive and your family a safe and satisfying holiday season.  Sally F / Service Liaison
Always the best experience and people. Been here for 2 cats and our new puppy now for years

Ken, thank you so much for your 5-star rating!  It has been our collective pleasure to work with you and your animal family for the last several years, and we are glad you've chosen Duke Animal Hospital.  Please know that we appreciate your taking the time to post.  Take care, and give our best to Benji.  Sally F / Service Liaison

⭐ Very Disappointed and Deeply Unsatisfied with Our Experience ⭐

I feel compelled to share our experience so other pet owners in Chicago can make an informed choice — because there are many clinics in the city, and this one would absolutely be the last choice.
My fiancé and I had an extremely unprofessional experience at this clinic. Our 8-year-old dog, who we treat like a child, was not given the care or attention she deserved. She had been refusing food for 2–3 days but was still drinking water, and shaking badly, which for us was a clear sign something was wrong. Despite our concern and the fact that she had been hospitalized just two months prior, the doctor insisted everything looked normal after a basic exam and pushed for an unnecessary X-ray — which felt more like a way to increase the bill than to help our dog.
Unfortunately, the visit only made things worse. Our dog’s condition declined, and we had to rush to VEG Emergency Hospital — which we highly recommend despite being expensive, because they truly care and act fast when your pet needs help.
What made things even more disappointing was the lack of compassion afterward. My fiancé sent a detailed email describing everything that happened — and we never received a response or a follow-up call. Only after she posted a negative review did someone finally reach out, not to ask how our dog was doing, but simply to discuss the review itself.
If you’re looking for a clinic that truly cares about your pet’s health and well-being, please look elsewhere. We would never want anyone to go through what we experienced here.

The Staff at Duke Animal Hospital are superior to most. The team members go above and beyond to care for your fur baby. My heart was so full after having my dog cared for, especially knowing that they would stay commited to her needs, in a moment of deep despair.

If your fur baby is not doing well, go directly to Duke Animal Hospital to get the right treatment with the ethical choice.
Friendly staff and great areas for kids. Have drink selection and separate waiting area for dog and cats

Took our geriatric calico in for a check-up and some meds, and the experience was fantastic! The front desk staff were very welcoming and kind, and Dr. Adler was both professional and understanding of our cat’s needs. Our floof didn’t seem agitated or upset afterward—which is a first! We also really appreciate that they have separate entrances for dogs and cats, plus convenient parking. Highly recommend!

I’m writing this review as my dog is still at the vet after emergency surgery under their care, BUT I have to give this vet 5 stars.

My 12.5 year old pup went to the ER (Veterinary Emergency Group - VEG, another amazing vet) on Monday 9/7 due to not eating for multiple days. Turns out he had a foreign object in his intestines that he was not able to pass. After returning from the emergency vet, I had went back 12 hours later for one last x-ray to see if the object was hopefully moving to the colon to avoid surgery - and it wasn’t. Emergency surgery was inevitable if I wanted to save his life . I was initially quoted 8k-12k by the ER vet (absolutely not) and I started to have a really bad feeling I would not be able to find somewhere “cheap” enough to be able to afford the life saving surgery. I called around to other vets that had the capability all to hear their quotes were anywhere from 4k-7k which was obviously much better than the initial ER quote. Still, this was a huge sum of money to come up with even with having pet insurance since you still need to come up with the money before getting reimbursed. I started searching Reddit and found Duke hospital mentioned as a more low cost option. I had called as soon as they opened, they said they could get me in same day and estimated that the emergency surgery would be around $3200. I was literally SO RELIEVED when I had heard that because I was quickly losing hope that I would be able to get his surgery and would inevitably have to put him down. I just received the text that he is out of surgery and recovering well from the anesthesia. The doctors at this hospital were very prompt and informative and went over every possible negative outcome that could happen. They gave me a “low end quote” of $3200 and a higher quote to cover anything additional to at might arise which was $3500.  I can’t say enough positive things about this animal hospital especially in today’s world where everything is sooooo expensive.  With both the ER visit and  the $3200 for his surgery, I was able to keep costs very close to what I have for his insurance coverage. So, THANK YOU DUKE ANIMAL HOSPITAL!!! You and your staff/doctors are angels and I will recommend you to anyone in the area needing a reputable and reasonable vet.

Tristan, thanks so much for the 5-stars - all of us at Duke Animal Hospital appreciate it!  It's been our pleasure to work with you and your family in support of your pets' health.  Take care, and please give our best to Gus and Mirana.  Sally F / Service Liaison
These folks are really on the ball. They are friendly. They didn't make me wait.  And they jumped at several opportunities to go above and beyond.  I'm really glad that I discovered them!

Bobby, thank you so much for the 5-stars!  All of us at Duke Animal Hospital are glad you found your way to us and have enjoyed meeting the various members of your animal family.  We look forward to working with you and Robert to support their health and well-being.  Know how much we appreciate your taking the time to post, and give our best to Scully, Snowy, Zeus and Ms. Momo.  Take care, Sally F /Service Liaison

Frank, thank you for the 5 stars!  Most of us here have had the pleasure of interacting with Murray and some of us remember him as a puppy!  We are so glad that you and Lucy chose Duke Animal Hospital to provide care for Murray and look forward to many more years of working with the three of you.  Know how much we appreciate your taking the time to post - and please give our best to Murray!  Take care,
Sally F / Service Liaison

Don’t hesitate, this is the answer to your pet’s emergency. The care my dog and I were shown changed our day and stopped a medical emergency. Everyone is lovely, priced like a vet, not like a hospital.
Great veterinarian organization!  Knowledgeable, friendly, clean, and convenient.

Chie, thank you for the 5-star rating.  It has certainly been our pleasure to work with you and Neal the last decade (!), and we are grateful you've chosen Duke Animal Hospital as health care provider for your bunny family.  Please give our best to Mousse - he's a magical little fellow!  Take care, and thanks again.  Sally F / Service Liaison

Amanda, thanks so much for your 5-star review.  It's not immediately clear which Duke Animal Hospital patient is connected with you, but know that all of us are appreciative!  Sally F / Service Liaison

Great staff, everyone is truly wonderful. My pup loves to go there. It actually makes her
happy. Super vets, fantastic vet techs, great service all around.

Had a new-vet appointment for my cat and Dr Saddler & Zach the Tech were both awesome with handling him. I feel like Zach went above & beyond with helping clean our carrier / swap the towel, and Dr Saddler gave a super clear explanation of what’s probably going on and what next steps look like. Getting an appointment was fairly easy and prices felt very reasonable, easy 5 stars

They got magoo in quickly for a dental, and 2 extractions. Very professionally handled.

Update they have become very cost driven. I took my pup in months ago for an ear problem. So they could establish a med, fast forward several months later he runs out of med, I call for a refill and am told need another visit! 😬 not to mention a $300 senior check up.

I’ve found an alternate vet, that really puts the animal  first!

I believe I was intentionally misled in my appointments with my bird, who was in critical condition.  I had two appointments and during my second appointment, I had a test run on my bird to detect bacterial infections.  This test indicated that there was an influx of “gram positive bacteria” but the vet marked it as normal despite her exhibiting severe discomfort.  But days later she was taken to an emergency vet late at night in which they determined the cause was the previously identified gram positive bacteria.  This was a shock, especially since Duke recommended I do the test with them.  I feel deceived and out the money that could have otherwise headed my bird sooner.  The negligence no doubt contributed to my bird’s worsened condition.

**Update:
Following my original review about my bird's care at Duke Animal Hospital, I received an email from the clinic that I feel further highlights why I lost trust in their approach.

In that message, they confirmed that a gram stain performed during my second visit showed gram-positive bacteria. Despite my bird showing clear signs of discomfort at the time, they deemed these results “normal flora.”  In Duke’s response below, you can even read how the results were interpreted as “can be considered normal.”  Just days later, an emergency vet diagnosed my bird with an overgrowth of gram-positive bacteria and yeast—findings that directly aligned with what Duke had already observed, but chose not to act on.

Rather than acknowledging the possibility of a missed opportunity to intervene earlier, the clinic insisted the later findings were “new” and that no oversight occurred. While I understand that avian illnesses can progress quickly, it’s hard to accept that the presence of bacteria combined with visible symptoms was not taken more seriously.

What felt especially disappointing was that instead of addressing my concerns with empathy, they ended the professional relationship—citing a “lack of trust” after my review. At no point did I place blame for offering the test; my issue lies with how the results were interpreted and communicated.

Ultimately, I feel that my bird’s suffering could have been lessened had Duke taken a more proactive approach.  I want to emphasize that I am not making this review as a targeted attack, but to make aware other bird owners an experience that could make a difference.  I’m sharing this in hopes that others seeking avian care remain vigilant and feel empowered to speak up when something doesn’t feel right.

Paul, thank you.  We are honored that you and Amy chose Duke Animal Hospital for Sammy's care and appreciate collaborating with you to support her well-being.  Know that your 5-star post touches us all.  Take care, and give Sammy our best.  Sally F / Service Liaison

Highly recommend. Beautiful facility, friendly and helpful staff. My 7 y/o 80lb dog recently developed diabetes - Dr Benjamin & team have been a godsend. I love that I see her & the same team Every Single Appointment - not a different vet every visit like other places. She is patient - never rushes me through the appointment, listens and answers every single question. She is very thorough and detail oriented. The team is very communicative over the phone and via online portal messaging. Their diabetes monitoring and care has been invaluable. I recommend them to anyone in the area with a pet.

Duke Animal Hospital’s Doctors and Staff are all wonderful, kind, caring and compassionate. We’ve been taking our two cats here for over a year and a half now and have had one (what felt major to us) surgery and couldn’t be happier with everyone involved. 10/10 will continue to return.

Super kind and caring staff! They take the time to listen and make sure you have no more questions before leaving. They are very quick to respond to concerns when we are at home, as well as, with filling prescriptions. They are transparent with prices and give honest answers about what needs attention now vs what can wait for a near future appointment. Highly recommend Duke for all your vet needs!
Brett, thanks for the 5-star shout out.  We're not 100% certain which pet patient you are connected with, but appreciate the post!  Sally F / Service Liaison

Recently changed veterinarian and so happy we did.  Although the issue with our pup has not been identified and cured, we are confident that it will be.  Everyone is so kind and Dr. Sadler takes time to listen and involves everyone in decisions giving options for care. No hard sell for expensive tests.  Follow up is fast for calls and emails from team members.  You can't ask for better care.  We been going to veterinarians for 45 years, and this is by far the best we've seen.
Great services and did not cost and arm and a leg. Will be making them our regular vet.

I have gone to Duke a few times with my cat and I was always pleased with my experience. However, I will never be more grateful for the love and care my mom and I received this past weekend when we brought our pitbull, Baby, in.

From the moment we arrived, the staff was so gentle and kind to our sweet, anxious boy. I briefly mentioned that I get nervous with him around other dogs (you never know) and they immediately knew what to do to make all of us comfortable.

We brought Baby in because he was experiencing rapid breathing, and we thought it would be pneumonia or something similar. Throughout the visit, the staff was so gentle and thoughtful with Baby as well as my mom and I. Pitbulls have an undeserved bad reputation, and we have unfortunately not always had the best vet experiences due to it. That was absolutely not the case here.

At the end, they had to deliver some very tough news to us, and I am so thankful that we were able to hear the news from this staff.

It’s been a sad week, and I am sad to say that Baby is no longer with us. However, I will be forever grateful for the love and care we all received during our visit. It has brought some light to a dark week.

Thank you so much for prioritizing pets over financial gain. At no point during our visit did we feel like it was about anything other than Baby’s quality of life. Thank you. ❤️

Ibrahim, thank you!  While we're not sure which pet patient you're connected with, all of us at Duke Animal Hospital appreciate your taking the time to post - and for 5 stars!  Sally F - Service Liaison

Had an extremely negative experience here a few years ago, that in retrospect, makes me extraordinarily angry. I brought my cat in for a regular checkup, because she was having excess hairballs. Dr. Coulombe misdiagnosed her with a heart murmur because her heartbeat was "too slow." On record, her heartbeat was a normal rate for a cat, but because she was in a vet's office, they determined that she should have "been more scared", and therefore "have a higher heart rate." Now that murmur hasn't been seen in ANY of the vet appointments I have had since then at a different vet, but it definitely exists on her medical records and my pet insurance is higher because of it. As soon as Dr. Coulombe told me about this mysterious "murmur," she had the tissues AT THE READY for when I started to cry from concern, and then at the end of the appointment she FORGOT ENTIRELY about why I even came– to recommend treatment for hairballs! They wanted to schedule an extremely expensive echocardiogram for WHAT? A kitty heart valve replacement?? They just want your money, and don't care if it leaves you in tears. This place disgusts me.

My dog had to have an incredibly expensive emergency surgery and I’m so glad I took her to Duke for it. They were very empathetic about the situation and made it possible for me to afford the surgery. I also appreciated the consistent updates and check-ins while she was in surgery and after while she recovered. A couple months later, my guinea pig passed away and I was met with the same empathy and kindness. Every experience I’ve had here has been very personalized and genuine. I appreciate everyone at Duke so much !

Most supportive and accommodating animal hospital I've ever encountered.

I have been in the vet field on and off for 5 years now. As a pet owner and vet tech, I have been wildly impressed. My pet rats visit Duke and I would rather not bring them elsewhere. They have superb communication, amazing client support, and do their best to make sure your pet gets seen in a timely manner. I can usually get an appointment within a few days and never had to wait very long in the exam room. Although they are not an specialized exotics clinic, Dr. Sadler works well with my rats and it's clear he does his homework. I was also blown away by Christina, the end of life support technician. I have never felt more supported and cared for during a euthanasia. Sometimes these values and experiences can be hard to find in the field.

Also, they always have la croix in the fridge. A+ clinic.

I recently had a disappointing experience at Duke Animal Hospital that I feel compelled to share. While I have had positive interactions with the front desk staff in the past, my visit on January 28, 2025, at 1:30 PM left much to be desired.

I accidentally arrived early for my appointment (2 hours), owned the scheduling oversight, and politely inquired if there was an option to be seen sooner. I even suggested checking in as an emergent visit to avoid making another trip on the same day. However, the receptionist didn’t even bother to get up from her chair to check with the medical staff or explore whether this could be accommodated. Instead, I was met with a dismissive attitude and a lack of effort to find any solution.  From a rhetoric perspective a "sorry we'd love to but we're absolutely slammed today..." would have gone a long way.

The front desk staff on this day seemed apathetic and unengaged. As if they didn't even want to be there or that if one other person were to come into the clinic, it would be so inconvenient for them.  One of them stared at me with a smug expression, and the employee whom I was conversing with at the front desk adopted an unprofessional "you're out of luck" attitude. It was clear that finding a solution or providing empathetic customer service was not a priority for either of them.

As someone who has established care here after moving to Chicago, this was a disappointing departure from the level of service I had previously experienced. As an investor and business owner myself, I know how critical it is to hire staff who embody a solutions-oriented and empathetic approach—especially in an industry where clients are entrusting the care of their beloved pets. Unfortunately, the sentiment I encountered today would leave any prospective or existing client questioning their choice in veterinary care.

I hope this feedback prompts some reflection and improvements in staff training and customer service. Clients come to veterinary clinics looking for care and understanding, and it’s essential that this starts at the front desk.
Sourabh, all of us at Duke Animal Hospital appreciate your 5-star review!  Please give our best to your special Corgi guy, and thank you.  Sally F / Service Liaison

I have never come across a veterinarian establishment like Duke. They truly go above and beyond, and make you and your pet feel like family. When we lost our sweet 2 year old cat to an undiagnosed terminal illness, the entire staff reached out personally with a signed card, and made a donation in his name to veterinary research. I have nothing but thanks and goodwill for these fine professionals.
Daniel, we're not certain which pet patient of Duke Animal Hospital you are connected with ... but thank you for your 5-star post.  We wish you a satisfying 2025 - Sally F / Service Liaison

Harrison, belated thanks to you from all of us at Duke Animal Hospital for your 5-star rating - we appreciate it!  We wish you a wonderful finish to 2024 and all the best in 2025.  Take care, Sally F / Service Liaison

Duke is simply the best vet in Chicago. No matter which Dr. you see (we've seen nearly everyone there!), you and your pet are absolutely guaranteed to get such thorough, compassionate, and timely care from their doctors, vet techs, and staff. Going to the vet is almost never fun for anyone involved, but we so deeply trust the team at Duke and are so grateful to them for how much they've helped us and our sweet Pepper!

Juan Carlos, thank you for the 5-star post!  We are glad that you and Gin decided to choose Duke Animal Hospital for her care.  It's been a pleasure meeting and working with you both, and we look forward to supporting Gin's health and well-being for years to come.  Know that we  all appreciate your taking the time to post.  Take care and our best to Ms. Gin.  Sally F / Service Liaison

Easy to get in with and staff is always super friendly. All the vets we’ve met are patient, understanding, and very informative. I recommend Duke Animal Hospital to anyone who’s looking to switch their pet :)
Been taking my dog here for years and have always had a great experience. Prices are reasonable and they’re always so good with my girl.

I'm very sad to have to update this review. My family has been patients at Duke for years, and we've had a lot of really amazing experiences. Used to have a 5/5 rating. Some of the best communication I've ever received from a team.

I have to update it because twice now I've come to them concerned about some symptoms we've seen. They weren't acute, but noticeable changes that would have meant catching something early. Both times we were sent home and told it's not a big deal.

One led to the end of my dog's life, the other lost 25 lbs before it was taken seriously. In both cases, the second opinion we saw once symptoms worsened said that these were common ailments for their breeds and could have seen massive improvement if caught early.

I can no longer in good faith recommend Duke Animal hospital. The communication is best of the best. But the care is expensive, and the quality just hasn't been there for our experience. Very sad.

Fallon, thanks so much for your 5-star review.  It's been our pleasure to meet you, =^..^= Sato and =^..^= Sammy, and we're glad you found your way to Duke Animal Hospital.  We look forward to continuing to collaborate with you in support of their health and well-being.  Take care, and know how appreciative we all are!  Sally F / Service Liaison
Amazing service! Very friendly and super accommodating!

Bhargav, thanks for the 5- star review!  All of us at Duke Animal Hospital are happy that you and adorable Ms. Penny found your way to us, and we look forward to working with you for years to come in support of Penny's health and well being.  Know that we're all appreciative of your post.  Take care and give Penny our best!  Sally F / Service Liasion
